summary: Bright Harbour is down to three vendors — us, Gong and Chorus — having ruled out Fireflies for weak coaching. Gong is the internal favourite for political rather than product reasons: their VP used it before and trusts it. Dana's own objections to Gong are price and paying for a full revenue suite when they want about a third of it, and Chorus lost on summary quality.

follow_up_email.subject: Side-by-side for your decision meeting on the 20th
follow_up_email.body:
Hi Dana,

As promised, something you can put in front of Ryan side by side.

The short version: every line in the notes links back to the moment in the call it came from, so a claim you cannot verify does not survive to be read. That is the part the suite does not do, and it is why this is not a downgrade on the thing he already trusts.

Happy to join the meeting on the 20th if useful.

Sam
